about: shared/test-vectors/rounding.json: the answer book for rounding money (03 §8, ADR-0024). round_money(amount, step) rounds an amount half-up to a multiple of the shop's rounding step (the setting money.rounding_step, default 1 shilling) and writes it with two places. Half-up means a half goes away from zero: 458.5 → 459 and −2.5 → −3 (JavaScript's Math.round gives −2). Some cases are here because a version written with floats gets them wrong (1.65 ÷ 1.10 is 1.4999… in floats). Python (backend/tests/test_vectors.py) and TypeScript (from UI-1) must both give every expect exactly. Every number is text, in quotes: a bare JSON number is read as a float. Fake numbers only.
